# Tubi

> > Tubi is a free ad-supported streaming service offering movies, TV series, and live TV channels across multiple platforms including Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, and smart TVs.

Tubi provides on-demand streaming content and 24/7 live channels spanning genres from true crime and news to sports, comedy, and reality shows. Available on iOS, Android, gaming consoles (Xbox, Playstation), and major streaming devices without subscription fees.

## Key Topics

- Free streaming
- Live TV channels
- Ad-supported video on demand (AVOD)
- Roku
- Amazon Fire TV
- Apple TV
- True crime programming
- News channels
- Watch schedules
- Original series
- Sports documentaries
- UNINTERRUPTED network
- Multi-platform availability
- Samsung Smart TVs
- Comedy series

## Live TV Channels

- [Dateline 24/7](https://tubitv.com/live/711410/dateline-24-7): Dateline 24/7 true crime channel streaming continuously
- [Law&Crime](https://tubitv.com/live/400000251/law-crime): Law&Crime live channel with bodycam footage & true crime shows
- [CBC News](https://tubitv.com/live/555130/cbc-news): CBC News live channel covering Canada and world stories
- [Estrella News](https://tubitv.com/live/560215/estrella-news): 24-hour Spanish language news live TV channel
- [Mysterious Worlds](https://tubitv.com/live/715946/mysterious-worlds): Live TV channel streaming unexplained mysteries 24/7
- [Top Rank Classics](https://tubitv.com/live/400000055/top-rank-classics): Top Rank boxing classics live channel with historic matches
- [Anger Management](https://tubitv.com/live/682059/anger-management): Charlie Sheen comedy series live channel on anger therapy
- [The Biggest Loser](https://tubitv.com/live/677790/the-biggest-loser): The Biggest Loser transformation reality show live channel

## Original Series & Networks

- [UNINTERRUPTED Network](https://tubitv.com/networks/uninterrupted): UNINTERRUPTED network featuring LeBron James & athlete content
- [Then You Run](https://tubitv.com/series/300015875/then-you-run): Thriller series set in Rotterdam with four women on holiday
- [Stuck With You](https://tubitv.com/series/300016539/stuck-with-you): Celebrity marriage drama with Tammy Townsend & Timon Kyle Durrett
